user.title: Connect to a Brilliantly Local agent
user.description: Enter the address of the Brilliant panel running the agent and the agent token (stored at /var/brilliant-local/token on the panel). To use agents on more panels, add them afterwards from this integration's Configure menu.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the agent.

abort.home_already_configured: This Brilliant home is already set up. Add this agent from the existing entry's Configure menu instead.

init.title: Agents
init.description: Each panel can run its own agent. With an agent on every panel, commands go straight to the panel that owns the light, and other agents take over when one is unreachable.

menu_options.add_agent: Add an agent on another panel

add_agent.title: Add an agent
add_agent.description: Address and token of an agent running on another panel in this home (token at /var/brilliant-local/token on that panel).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the agent.
error.wrong_home: That agent belongs to a different Brilliant home.
error.agent_already_added: That agent is already part of this entry.
